description: Na₂La₂Ti₃O₁₀ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4/mmm space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five equivalent O atoms. There is one shorter (2.30 Å) and four longer (2.74 Å) Na-O bond lengths. La is bonded to twelve O atoms to form LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with eight equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with five equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.56-2.91 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-2.32 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ti-O bond lengths are 1.94 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four equivalent La and two Ti atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OLa₄Ti₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°. All O-La bond lengths are 2.75 Å. The O-Ti bond length is 2.32 Å. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent La and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to five equivalent Na and one Ti atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Ti octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-4°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to four equivalent La and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four equivalent La and two Ti atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OLa₄Ti₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-10°.
